title: Clapping the syllables in long words
examples: How many syllables are in hippopotamus?

explain.say: Let's clap a word together! Say banana and clap on each beat: ba, na, na. Three claps! Each beat is called a syllable, a chunk of a word with one vowel sound. Look, the board splits banana into three chunks.

draw.text: Clapping the syllables in long words

explain.say: Here is a trick to check. Put your hand under your chin and say tiger. Your chin drops once for ti and once for ger. See the two chunks on the board? Two drops, two syllables. How many syllables are in your name?

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: Your chin drops once for each beat

explain.say: Now a giant word: hippopotamus! Don't panic. Look at the board, it breaks the word into small bites. The first chunk lights up: hip. Say it with me.
Keep going: hip, po, pot, a, mus. See the third chunk glowing? Each chunk has one vowel sound. That makes five syllables. A long word is just short chunks in a row. Can you clap all five?
You are a syllable champion! Try this one on the board: cat, er, pil, lar. Four claps. Wow fact: a village in Wales has a 58-letter name, and people still say it by breaking it into chunks!

faq.a: A syllable is one beat in a word, a chunk with one vowel sound. Cat has one, tiger has two and banana has three.
asks: How many syllables are in a word?

faq.a: Clap on each beat, or put your hand under your chin. Your jaw drops once for each syllable, because every syllable has a vowel sound.

faq.q: How do syllables help with spelling?
faq.a: Long words are hard to spell all at once. Split them into syllables, like Sep, tem, ber, and spell one chunk at a time.
asks: How do I spell long words?

faq.q: Does every syllable have a vowel?
faq.a: Every syllable has a vowel sound. Sometimes the letter y does that job, as in my, or the last beat of happy.

faq.q: What is the longest word in English?
faq.a: Big dictionaries list pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis, a lung disease, with 45 letters. Broken into syllables it is much easier to say.

facts: The Welsh village Llanfairpwllgwyngyllgogerychwyrndrobwllllantysiliogogogoch has a 58-letter name.
A haiku poem traditionally has three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sound beats.

quiz.say: Which word has only one syllable?
quiz.show: Which word has only one syllable?
quiz.why: strength has eight letters but only one vowel sound, so one beat.
